title: The Truth Mara Exposes

audience_goal.summary: Female 18-34 viewers who enjoy romance and revenge drama
audience_goal.success_metric: Sustain curiosity and emotional investment through the final reveal

commercial_goal.summary: Create a sequel-driving revenge episode with a debatable conspiracy reveal

story_goal: Create a dark romance revenge story where a woman exposes the powerful man who betrayed her, but discovers a deeper conspiracy.

creative_brief.hook: Mara publicly exposes the man who betrayed her and immediately uncovers evidence of a deeper conspiracy.

creative_brief.target_emotion: anger to suspense to guarded hope
